locations.note: B.J. walks through occupied Roswell to plant a bomb in the Oberkommando base beneath the town.
B.J. returns to the family farm outside Mesquite to confront his father.
Manhattan lies in ruins after the atomic bomb; the resistance hides in the Empire State Building.
New Orleans has been walled off as a ghetto; B.J. breaks in to recruit Horton Boone.
The final fight takes place on a propaganda film set in occupied Hollywood.
B.J. is put on trial and taken to the Lincoln Memorial for a televised execution.
A resistance cell hides in the Empire State Building amid the atomic ruins of Manhattan.

routes.name: B.J.'s liberation tour
routes.note: B.J. goes from Roswell to his family farm in Mesquite, the ruins of Manhattan and walled-off New Orleans, is put on trial in Washington and fights the last battle in Hollywood.
